image.name: freshrss
image.description: [Freshrss](https://freshrss.org/) is a free, self-hostable aggregator for rss feeds.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.20. Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Added php-exif module to resolve issue with fever api.
Existing users should update: site-confs/default.conf - Cleanup default site conf.
Split cron into separate init step and set crontab permissions.
Fix cron init to properly migrate existing installations to new app location.
Rebasing to alpine 3.15 with php8. Restructure nginx configs ([see changes announcement](https://info.linuxserver.io/issues/2022-08-20-nginx-base)).
Internalize app and enable updates for existing users, allow user customized crontab.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Add multi arch and pipeline logic.
Update nginx config to resolve api not working.
Rebase to alpine linux 3.5 and nginx.
Add Sqlite support for standalone operation.

image.title: Freshrss
image.setup_instructions:
Access the webui set up wizard at `http://serverIP:port`

For external databases, create a user and database in your mysql/mariadb server (not root) and then follow the setup wizard in the webui. Use the IP address for "host" of your database server.

Additional extensions can be dropped into `/config/www/freshrss/extensions` and will be active after container restart.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  freshrss:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/freshrss:latest
    container_name: freshrss
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/freshrss/config:/config
    ports:
      - 80:80
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=freshrss \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 80:80 \
  -v /path/to/freshrss/config:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/freshrss:latest
